---
title: "phpolars"
subtitle: "Polars data frames for PHP"
---

phpolars is a PHP extension, written in Rust, that runs [Polars](https://pola.rs) inside PHP. Polars is a columnar data frame library: a `DataFrame` holds typed columns, and expressions such as `col('units')->mul(col('price'))` describe computations that Polars runs on its own threads, outside PHP. A query that reads a CSV file, filters it, and groups it runs in Polars. PHP values are created only when the code asks for them, for example with `toDicts()`.

The API follows py-polars, Polars' Python package, with camelCase method names and snake_case functions. The test suite compares 314 cases with py-polars 1.43.2, and all of them match; [Compatibility and limitations](compatibility.qmd) lists what that comparison covers and what phpolars leaves out.

{{< include examples/_quickstart.md >}}

The example reads `sales.csv`, the example data from the docs. [Getting started](getting-started.qmd#a-starter-script) has a complete script with its imports, and the command that downloads the data.

## What it includes

- `DataFrame` and `LazyFrame` with py-polars' methods: `select`, `withColumns`, `filter`, `sort`, `groupBy`/`agg`, `join`, `unique`, `pivot`, `unpivot`, `explode`, `describe`, and more.
- Expressions with arithmetic, three-valued logic, aggregations, window functions (`over`), `when`/`then`/`otherwise`, and the `str`, `dt`, `list`, `struct`, and `name` namespaces.
- `Series`, with the same expression methods.
- CSV, Parquet, JSON, NDJSON, and Arrow IPC reading and writing, with lazy scans and streaming sinks, and reading and writing through PDO.
- SQL queries over data frames.
- A thread-pool cap for PHP-FPM (`php_polars.max_threads`).

## The phpolars API or phibble and phplyr

phpolars can be used directly or through [phibble](https://phibble.phpstats.org) and [phplyr](https://phplyr.phpstats.org).

- The phpolars API (`Phpolars\DataFrame`, `LazyFrame`, `Series`, and expressions) follows Polars and its semantics. A missing value is `null`, and aggregates skip it.
- phibble's `Phibble\Polars\PolarsTable` adapter runs phibble tables and phplyr pipelines in Polars. It belongs to phibble, and phpolars supplies the extension that it runs on. The pipeline keeps dplyr's semantics, in which `null` is R's `NA`, and the same code also runs on phibble's in-memory `DataFrame` and on SQL tables.

[phibble and phplyr](phibble.qmd) covers the adapter and the differences between the two sets of semantics.
